id: title:fasyy612:block playback when a mutation is oversized

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a runtime check and state tracking for oversized DOM mutations in session recordings, potentially preventing playback and displaying an error when the recorded DOM exceeds a size threshold.
review.reason: The implementation adds a feature flag check, a boolean state variable, and the associated logic to detect oversized DOM mutations. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement: it establishes a new guardrail for recording playback. However, the tier is not raised to 3 because the implementation does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or changes across
review.uncertainty: The exact threshold and the complete implementation of the error display and playback prevention are not fully visible in the provided hunks, and the benefit relies on the effectiveness of the size check rather than a demonstrated systemic improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive implementation of a new feature: detecting oversized DOM mutations in session recordings. All hunks are related and demonstrate the complete change. No unrelated PRs are present.

observations.behavior: Adds a new feature flag and checks for oversized mutations in recording snapshots.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the Replay Oversized Recording Gate feature flag is enabled, then iterates over snapshots to count events with many added nodes, returning true if the count exceeds a threshold.

observations.behavior: Adds a new state value to track oversized mutation detection.
observations.posthog_connection: Stores the result of the oversized mutation check in the session recording player's state, used to prevent playback and show an error.
